title: Lost-response replay for decomposition after its own parent revision advance: revision-independent auto key with a guarded pending-attempt refresh
outcome: Lost-response replay for decomposition after its own parent revision advance: revision-independent auto key with a guarded pending-attempt refresh
acceptance: a keyless ordinary child add whose response is lost replays after rereading the advanced parent, with no duplicate child and no second event
a pending attempt that lost a concurrent parent-revision race is refreshed by the identical reread retry under CAS, expected-revision, and authority guards instead of a permanent idempotency conflict
a runless restored parent's run bootstrap does not change the auto key, so its lost-response retry replays

completion.summary: Lost-response decomposition replay is revision-independent, strictly basis-guarded, CAS-safe and agent-actionable; retained-basis health and regression coverage landed.
